sources.label: Data sources
sources.intro: Where the collection page gets its data. Keys are stored in the site's database and never shown again once saved; anything in .env.backend still works, and what you enter here takes priority.

placeholder.admin: Saved. Enter a new one to replace it
placeholder.adminHint: Saved · ends in {{hint}}. Enter a new one to replace it
placeholder.env: Using the value from .env.backend. Enter one to override it

sources.cleared: Cleared what was entered here for {{name}}

tmdb.name: TMDB
tmdb.help: Sign in at themoviedb.org → Settings → API, and copy the long "API Read Access Token" (not the shorter API Key).

simkl.name: Simkl
simkl.help: Create an app at simkl.com/settings/developer for the Client ID; get the Access Token with the PIN flow in the Simkl API docs.

bahamut.name: Bahamut Anime Crazy
bahamut.what: Watch history from Bahamut Anime Crazy (Taiwan)
bahamut.help: Your Bahamut account and password. If family members share the account they'll sign each other out; this signs back in automatically.

googleBooks.name: Google Books
googleBooks.what: Look up titles and covers by ISBN
googleBooks.help: Lookups work without it (falling back to Open Library). To add one, enable the Books API in the Google Cloud Console and create an API key for a much larger quota.

ncl.name: National Central Library (Taiwan)
ncl.what: Books published in Taiwan, with their Chinese titles by ISBN
ncl.help: No key needed. Once on, it downloads the library's new-book list once a day.

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.help: Create an app at developer.spotify.com and use the Redirect URI below. Save the Client ID and Secret, press "Connect Spotify account", then paste the refresh token from the page you land on and save.

steam.name: Steam
steam.help: Get a Web API key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey; the Steam ID is 17 digits. Your profile and game details must be public.

wakatime.name: WakaTime
wakatime.help: Copy the API key from wakatime.com/settings/api-key.

watchEmpty: No watch history yet. It shows up here once Bahamut or Simkl syncs.
watchNote: Synced records can't be edited — you can only choose whether they appear on the site. Films and TV shows can go in the top row of the collection page.
noTmdb: Not matched on TMDb, so it can't be a favorite
listenNote: Straight from Spotify (the last 50 plays). Here you can only choose which ones stay off the site.
listenEmpty: Nothing played recently. This stays empty if Spotify isn't connected.
favEmpty: No favorites yet. Press "☆ Favorite" under "Watching" to add one.
favNote: The top row of the collection page, in this order. Each one can have a short note.
